note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with HS codes and destinations (Netherlands, USA, UAE, UK, Italy) — not merely website claims. Per rule 4, revenue and domestic turnover are left null rather than estimated. No rejection grounds: the entity is active and shipping as of 2026-02-28. Role appears to be manufacturer-exporter of rubber sheets (own product descriptions with rubber-content specs), though the registry role field was not independently verified in this pass.
